code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny, nx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            border = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                      if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(cells) == border and r1-r0 >= 2 and c1-c0 >= 2:
                fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 == 1 else 2
                for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                    for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
